decisive_items: The patient had started receiving 1 mg of anastrozole daily 6 months prior to her presentation
Parafoveal shimmering golden crystalline deposits in both eyes
Crystalline deposits located at the level of the outer plexiform layers with some extension into the inner nuclear area subfoveally
response.rationale: Temporal association with anastrozole initiation and characteristic bilateral parafoveal crystalline deposits with SD-OCT localization support anastrozole-associated crystalline maculopathy.
